utility.name: INetSim
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Installs INetSim, which simulates common internet services (DNS, HTTP and HTTPS, SMTP, POP3, FTP, NTP, IRC and others) so that malware network behaviour can be observed on an isolated network. Every service listens on all interfaces, and the DNS service answers every A query with dns_default_ip. Where INetSim's own DNS service cannot run (Kali's Net::DNS refuses to start in INetSim's forked service processes), dnsmasq answers DNS in its place, logging queries to /var/log/inetsim/dns.log. With start_service false, INetSim is installed and configured but left stopped and disabled, for students to start themselves.
